# WinDivert dependency

Sema Redirector dynamically links to the official WinDivert 2.2.2 x64 binary distribution.

- Upstream: https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert
- Release asset: `WinDivert-2.2.2-A.zip`
- SHA-256: `63CB41763BB4B20F600B6DE04E991A9C2BE73279E317D4D82F237B150C5F3F15`
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later or GPL-2.0; see `LICENSE`

The checked-in files are the upstream header, x64 import library, DLL, signed x64 driver, README, VERSION, and LICENSE without modification.
